The Modern Craftsman is an essay series exploring software architecture, design tools, and the craft of computing. I believe great software is not born from frameworks, but from clarity of thought, reverence for fundamentals, and deep respect for the user.

I have spent the past fifteen years building developer infrastructure, visual editors, and distributed systems. When not writing or programming, I advise early-stage founders and mentor engineering apprentices.
